id: title:Gilbert09:skip tracking tempdb log full errors in table stats

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces false-positive error tracking and potential alert fatigue for warehouse metadata ingestion by treating SQL Server 9002 (tempdb log full) as a transient, self-recovering error.
review.reason: Adds a transient error classification and its helper, and updates warehouse metadata ingestion to skip this error.
